### Stephen Hahn's Biography

Steven joined Hotel Equities through our strategic alliance with Coakley & Williams where he oversaw corporate services which include information technology and office administration. In his new role, Stephen collaborates across all disciplines to improve IT's role in streamlining processes and creating efficiencies. Previously, Stephen held the positions of Chief information Officer and General Manager with Coakley & Williams. In addition to earning his Associate of Arts degree in Hospitality Services Management, he earned his Bachelor of Science Degree in Business Administration from the University of Maryland University College, College Park, MD. He then further advanced his computer-related expertise by earning his Master of Applied Computer Systems Degree from the University of Maryland University College, College Park, MD. In his free time, Stephen likes to randonneur cycle.

Source: Hotel Equities on 04/12/2022

In a recent feature with HOTEL MANAGEMENT Magazine, Stephen Hahn, Vice President of Information Technology at Hotel Equities, shares how the company is leveraging technology, automation, and AI to create meaningful operational improvements across its portfolio.

From streamlining workflows and enhancing labor efficiency to empowering property teams with better insights, Stephen's approach is rooted in a simple philosophy: technology should make hospitality stronger, not more complicated.

"We don’t adopt technology because it’s trendy. We evaluate whether it genuinely improves operations, supports associates, and drives better performance for owners. If it creates unnecessary complexity, we move on."

By combining operational expertise with an entrepreneurial mindset, Hotel Equities continues to invest in a culture where innovation is part of everyday problem-solving.

Hotel Equities Appoints Brian Jenkins to Lead HE Labs, the Management Company’s New Innovation Division 

### Hotel Equities Appoints Brian Jenkins to Lead HE Labs, the Management Company’s New Innovation Division 

 May 29, 2026 

ATLANTA, Ga. — Hotel Equities (HE), a best-in-class hospitality operator, announces the appointment of Brian Jenkins as Head of HE Labs™, Hotel Equities' dedicated innovation and incubation platform built for evaluating emerging technologies, developing AI-driven workflows, and advancing new operating models designed to improve owner returns and hotel performance across the portfolio. In this role, Jenkins will oversee all HE Labs initiatives, from testing and evaluation to deployment, ensuring each advances through a defined progression before being implemented at the property-level and scaled.

"Brian's background sits at the intersection of strategy and hospitality operations, and that combination is precisely what this role demands,” said Ben Rafter, Chief Executive Officer of Hotel Equities. “The industry has never had a shortage of technologies; what it has lacked is the discipline to evaluate them rigorously, integrate them seamlessly, and deploy only those that move the needle. HE Labs exists to deliver validated solutions to owners, not experiments, and Brian brings the discipline, operating perspective, and analytical rigor required to lead that work."

"The gap between what technology promises and what it actually delivers for owners is where HE Labs operates,” said Jenkins. “This is the right moment for this kind of platform. Our focus is to bring discipline to that gap: evaluating what works, deploying what fits, and scaling solutions that improve performance.”

Before leading HE Labs, Jenkins served as Executive Vice President of Strategic Initiatives, shaping Hotel Equities' broader technology and innovation strategy, conducting business development, and applying quantitative analysis to operational decision-making, including the development of the Hospitality Intelligence (H.I.) platform, Springboard's proprietary system blending technology and human insight to enhance operational efficiency. Previously, Jenkins held a series of strategic roles at Springboard Hospitality, which he joined in 2016 ahead of its combination with Hotel Equities in 2025.

# Brett M.

Director of Information Technology | Specializing in Enterprise IT Strategy & Business Systems Management | Successfully Developed and Executed Tech Strategy for a fast-growth, fast-paced Startup

Charleston, South Carolina, United States (US)

405 connections • 427 followers

## About

Like everyone else in high school, I had no idea what I wanted to be when I grew up. I always had a propensity for technology: playing games launched from DOS 3.0, creating a home network to share a single dial up connection (tying up the phone line to my mother’s chagrin!). But it never occurred to me that could translate into a successful career. It wasn’t until I took an intro to visual basic class in high school that my passion was ignited. I found I had a knack for solving problems and creating solutions to reach a specific outcome. Coding a fully operational version of the board game Risk was my crown achievement. I was hooked. Fast forward to today. I have been ingrained in the information technology field for over 17 years and still love every second of it. Though I didn’t specifically pursue computer programming, the lessons I learned extrapolate to all of IT. I have had the unique opportunity to manage IT systems across a multitude of different industries: from education and health care to small business and hospitality. And you know what, they want the same thing: use technology to facilitate the goals of the business in an efficient and cost-effective manner. Being an IT leader over the last 7 years has resulted in some truly exciting accomplishments. I successfully planned and executed a full datacenter move with minimal impact to operations. And I did this twice! Most recently, I have been building the IT strategy from the ground up at a face pace, fast growth startup hospitality company. I am proud to say that all our hard work has paid off as we were just acquired by Marriott. I am very much a hands on leader with a passion for solving business problems by designing standout, thoughtful solutions and processes. I do this using the tried and true KISS method: keep it simple stupid.

Total Experience: 20 years and 7 months
